text: Implemented rigid-plus-PE optimization through the cached projected-patch objective, exact matrix-free GN operator, Gale PCG, pose-eliminated damped system, loss-only nonnegative early rejection, physical trust metric, certified proposals, fixed selection checkpoints, and explicit rigid fallback. Added stationary convergence requiring both small undamped projected-gradient norm and small physical RMS step; severe damping alone cannot declare convergence. Independent analytic phantom suite covers representable two-mode truth, certified forward/inverse residual <= 1.1e-8 mm, exact zero-field rigid reduction, all-invalid fallback, dropout as bounded outlier cost, and measurable out-of-basis residual. Result records separate data/prior/selection objectives, nominal/effective rank, certificate margin/hash, and complete phase work; Krylov products report zero image interpolation/gradient calls; semantics explicitly say millimetres, anatomically guided inverse displacement, not Hz/off-resonance, and no dropout recovery. Gates: JVM PeFieldOptimizerSuite 5/5; Scala.js PeFieldOptimizerSuite 5/5; git diff --check clean.
